summary: Completed backend testing of FortexaRH modular routers refactoring. All 30 tests passed (100%). Tested: auth, company, employees, payroll, attendance, vacations, evaluations, recruitment (jobs/candidates), organigrama, accounting, system-users, dgii-reports, and dashboard endpoints. Frontend verified working correctly with login flow and dashboard loading.

minor.issue: Line 1077 in server.py: 'status.payment_status' should be 'payment_status' - undefined variable bug when payment is not completed
Lines 1485-1501 in server.py: 'webhook_response' is undefined - should use 'session_id' and 'event["id"]'. Also indentation issue on update_one call

Fix lines 1485-1501 in server.py: replace 'webhook_response.session_id' with 'session_id' and 'webhook_response.event_id' with 'event["id"]'
critical_code_review_comments: All modular routers correctly implement the get_current_user wrapper pattern with Request and HTTPBearer credentials
All routers properly use init_router() for database and auth dependency injection
Authentication flow working correctly - login returns JWT token, /auth/me validates token
Employee CRUD operations working with proper subscription limit checks
DGII reports correctly calculate TSS contributions and ISR based on Dominican Republic tax rates
Accounting module includes 3 chart of accounts templates (NIIF PYMES, Básico, Comercial)
System users module properly enforces admin-only operations
Two bugs found in payment-related endpoints (not part of router refactoring) - see minor issues
